name: Class
description: A Class is a lists entity used to track different segments of a business (income and expenses) independent of any particular client or project, applicable to an entire transaction or to individual detail lines.

update.note: Full update; the request body must include all writable fields as well as Id and SyncToken. Writable fields omitted from the body are set to null.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Required for update. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: User recognizable name for the Class.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object, used to lock an object for use by one app at a time. Required for update; attempts to modify an object specifying an older SyncToken fail.

fields.name: ParentRef
fields.description: The immediate parent of the SubClass. Conditionally required if this object is a subclass.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced parent Class object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The display name of the referenced parent Class object.

fields.name: SubClass
fields.description: Specifies whether this object is a subclass. true: this object represents a subclass; false or null: this object represents a top-level class.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: If true, this entity is currently enabled for use by QuickBooks.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the object. The MetaData values are set by Data Services and are read only for all applications.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was created in the source domain.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated in the source domain.

fields.name: FullyQualifiedName
fields.description: Fully qualified name of the entity. Prepends the topmost parent, followed by each sub class separated by colons (e.g. Parent:Class1:SubClass1:SubClass2). Limited to 5 levels.
